label: DEV: Run with Node.js
command: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.infra.yml up --build -d && npm run all:dev

label: DEV: Run with Node.js (Logging)
command: docker compose -f ../docker-compose.infra.yml up --build -d && npm run all:dev:log

label: NX: Generate Nest App
command: npx nx g @nx/nest:app --linter eslint --e2eTestRunner none --unitTestRunner none

label: NX: Generate Vue App
command: npx nx g @nx/vue:app --bundler vite --linter eslint --unitTestRunner none --e2eTestRunner none --inSourceTest false --routing true -s css

label: NX: Generate Vue lib
command: npx nx g @nx/vue:lib --linter eslint --unitTestRunner none --bundler vite --component true --inSourceTest false --minimal

label: NX: Generate TypeScript lib
command: npx nx g @nx/js:lib --bundler tsc --linter eslint --unitTestRunner none --minimal
